```{python}
#| echo: false
import graphviz
from IPython.display import Image as IPImage, display

from dih_models.plotting.graphviz_helper import setup_graphviz_style, render_graphviz_with_watermark

dot = graphviz.Digraph(comment="Return Ranking Map", format="png")
dot.attr(rankdir="LR", size="12,7", nodesep="0.5", ranksep="0.8")
setup_graphviz_style(dot)

dot.node("question", "How is the system funded?")
dot.node("positive", "NEW APPROPRIATION\nUse finite cost per DALY")
dot.node("zero", "REDIRECT ZERO-VALUE SPENDING\nNEW APPROPRIATION = $0\nADVOCACY SHORTHAND: ∞ NEW-BUDGET LEVERAGE")
dot.node("negative", "REDIRECT HARMFUL SPENDING\nADD THE AVOIDED HARM\nREDIRECT FIRST")

dot.node("positive_action", "Compare health per dollar")
dot.node("zero_action", "Budget-neutral, more health\nNot a full social ROI")
dot.node("negative_action", "Stop modeled harm + create health\nDominant in modeled net benefit")

dot.edge("question", "positive", label="new money")
dot.edge("question", "zero", label="zero-value budget")
dot.edge("question", "negative", label="negative-value budget")
dot.edge("positive", "positive_action")
dot.edge("zero", "zero_action")
dot.edge("negative", "negative_action")

png_path = render_graphviz_with_watermark(dot, "state-rtt-return-ranking-map")
display(IPImage(str(png_path)))
```
